title: Testing inequalities and Boolean data type

cues.en: In this video I'm going to show you how to test for inequalities in Python.
cues.zh: 這段影片示範，如何在 Python 裡檢查不等式。

cues.en: And I will also introduce you to the boolean data type. The boolean data type, Also sometimes called a logical data type.
cues.zh: 也會介紹布林資料型別，有時也稱為邏輯資料型別，

cues.en: is one of the most important data types in computing, in particular in scientific computing.
cues.zh: 這是運算，尤其科學運算裡，最重要的資料型別之一。

cues.en: Now if you're not familiar or maybe you've forgotten about inequalities and you have never heard of booleans before, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果你不熟悉，或忘了不等式，也從未聽過布林，別擔心。

cues.en: It's actually a really simple concept as you will see in a moment.
cues.zh: 其實概念很簡單，等一下就會看到。

cues.en: So first a quick reminder about inequalities and inequality is kind of like an equals sign.
cues.zh: 先快速複習不等式。不等號有點像等號，

cues.en: But it's a little bit less certain.
cues.zh: 但沒那麼確定，

cues.en: It's a bit more open ended.
cues.zh: 比較有彈性。

cues.en: So this statement here reads "four is greater than three" and that is obviously a true statement -- four is greater than three.
cues.zh: 這個敘述讀作「4 大於 3」，顯然是真的，4 確實大於 3。

cues.en: So this bracket sign here is opening up towards the larger number.
cues.zh: 這個尖括號形狀的符號，開口朝向較大的數字。

cues.en: So here you would say four is less than five.
cues.zh: 所以這裡讀作「4 小於 5」。

cues.en: So these are the first two symbols for inequalities.
cues.zh: 這是前兩個不等號。

cues.en: Then there's two other symbols that are worth knowing.
cues.zh: 另外還有兩個值得認識的符號。

cues.en: And that is four is greater than or equal to.
cues.zh: 這裡是「4 大於或等於」，

cues.en: That's how you pronounce this symbol here.
cues.zh: 這個符號是這樣唸的，

cues.en: So greater than or equal to two plus two.
cues.zh: 大於或等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: Now that's obviously true: four is not greater than two plus two Because two plus two equals four.
cues.zh: 這顯然成立。4 不大於 2 加 2，因為 2 加 2 等於 4，

cues.en: So four is equal to two plus two.
cues.zh: 但 4 等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: Here we say four is less than or equal to three plus two and again that's also true.
cues.zh: 這裡是「4 小於或等於 3 加 2」，也成立。

cues.en: This side is five this side is four that's four is not equal to five but four is less than or equal to five.
cues.zh: 這邊是 5，這邊是 4。4 不等於 5，但 4 小於或等於 5。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So you will see in a moment how to implement these four expressions in Python.
cues.zh: 等一下就會示範，如何在 Python 實作這四個運算式。

cues.en: And before I switch to Python I'm going to introduce you to a data type that's called boolean, sometimes it's also called logical.
cues.zh: 切換之前，先介紹布林資料型別，有時也稱為邏輯型別。

cues.en: Now in this data type there are only two values: true and false.
cues.zh: 這個型別只有兩個值：真和假。

cues.en: So this is just a binary data type something can be true or it can be false.
cues.zh: 也就是二元資料型別，一件事不是成立，就是不成立。

cues.en: Now python and different programming languages will sometimes print out the words true and false and
cues.zh: Python 和不同的程式語言，有時會印出 true、false 文字，

cues.en: sometimes they represent these as 0 and 1 where one is equivalent to true and zero is equivalent to false.
cues.zh: 有時則用 0 和 1 表示。1 對應真，0 對應假。

cues.en: So if you see one and zero, and they are a boolean or logical type, then this is not the number one.
cues.zh: 所以看到 1、0，如果它們是布林或邏輯型別，就不是一般的數字 1，

cues.en: And this is not the number zero.
cues.zh: 也不是一般的數字 0。

cues.en: This would be equivalent to trues, it's just a different way of representing true.
cues.zh: 這等同於真，只是用另一種方式表示，

cues.en: And this is a different way of representing false. That said, Python always prints out the words true and false so it's even easier to remember.
cues.zh: 這則是另一種表示假的方式。不過 Python 一律印出 True、False，更容易記住。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's switch to Python and see how this stuff gets implemented.
cues.zh: 切換到 Python，看看如何實作。

cues.en: So let's start off with a simple example.
cues.zh: 從簡單例子開始。

cues.en: I will say four greater than five.
cues.zh: 寫 4 大於 5。

cues.en: So this is how you implement the greater than sign.
cues.zh: 大於符號就是這樣寫。

cues.en: So now I'm going to press control enter on my keyboard and it says false.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+Enter，顯示 False。

cues.en: And this is actually the correct result because four is not greater than five.
cues.zh: 這是正確結果，因為 4 不大於 5。

cues.en: So it is incorrect -- it's false that four is greater than five.
cues.zh: 因此「4 大於 5」是錯的，也就是假。

cues.en: Now if I want to see what true looks like I could write four less than five like this and that prints out true.
cues.zh: 如果想看 True，可以寫 4 小於 5，就會印出 True。

cues.en: Now I can also set a variable to be a boolean.
cues.zh: 也能把變數設成布林值。

cues.en: So let's say be the very I'm going to create this variable B equals let's say 10 less then and I'm going
cues.zh: 建立變數 b，設定 b 等於，例如 10 小於，我要，

cues.en: to say three times three to show you that you can put an arithmetic expression on one side of this.
cues.zh: 寫 3 乘以 3，示範不等式其中一邊也能是算術式。

cues.en: So B equals 10 greater than three times three.
cues.zh: 所以 b 等於「10 大於 3 乘以 3」的結果。

cues.en: This is a kind of weird looking expression if you're not familiar with boolean data types.
cues.zh: 不熟悉布林型別的話，這個式子可能看起來很奇怪。

cues.en: But the thing to keep in mind is that this whole expression here is going to give one output -- it's either going to be true or false.
cues.zh: 但要記住，整個式子只會產生一個輸出，不是真，就是假。

cues.en: Now we know in this case this is going to be true because three times three is nine and ten is greater than nine.
cues.zh: 這次我們知道會是真，因為 3 乘以 3 是 9，而 10 大於 9。

cues.en: So this is going to be true.
cues.zh: 所以會是 True，

cues.en: And therefore I expect the value of b to be true.
cues.zh: 因此我預期 b 的值是 True。

cues.en: Now that's not this true, That was from the previous code that I ran.
cues.zh: 不是目前看到的這個 True，那是之前執行程式留下的。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I run this code again.
cues.zh: 重新執行這段程式，

cues.en: There's no output because we didn't request any output.
cues.zh: 沒有輸出，因為我們沒要求輸出。

cues.en: So I'm going to say print B and I can see that the value of B is true.
cues.zh: 寫 print(b)，就能看到 b 的值是 True。

cues.en: Now to prove to you that B is a boolean variable and not a string.
cues.zh: 接著證明，b 是布林變數，而不是字串。

cues.en: So it's not the word true, it's not the set of characters t r u e, it's actually the Boolean true.
cues.zh: 它不是 true 這個單字，不是 t、r、u、e 這組字元，而是布林值 True。

cues.en: I'm going to print out the type of this variable.
cues.zh: 我把變數的型別印出來。

cues.en: Now there's a special function in Python.
cues.zh: Python 有一個特殊函數，

cues.en: It's a built in function.
cues.zh: 是內建函數，

cues.en: You can see it's a built in function because it's green when I typed it.
cues.zh: 輸入時是綠色，所以能看出它是內建函數，

cues.en: And that is called type.
cues.zh: 叫做 type。

cues.en: So now what I'm requesting Python to do is print out not the variable itself but the type of the variable.
cues.zh: 我要 Python 印出的，不是變數本身，而是變數的型別。

cues.en: Now when I run this code you'll see this says class bool and this is shorthand for boolean.
cues.zh: 執行後會看到 class 'bool'，bool 是 boolean 的縮寫。

cues.en: So this is the data type or the class boolean.
cues.zh: 也就是布林資料型別，或布林類別。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now let's see if I can set this to be false.
cues.zh: 接著試試能不能讓它變成 False。

cues.en: I'm going to say three point three three three.
Well this is still going to be ....
cues.zh: 這樣仍然會是，

cues.en: I wanted to get this to print the value of B.
cues.zh: 我想印的是 b 的值。

cues.en: This is still true because now three times three three three actually I can even show you what this is.
cues.zh: 還是 True，因為現在 3 乘以 3.333，其實我可以直接算給你看，

cues.en: So we're still at nine nine nine.
And in fact, the more threes they get here.
cues.zh: 實際上，在後面再加更多個 3，

cues.en: Basically this is just going to be closer and closer to 10.
cues.zh: 基本上只是越來越接近 10。

cues.en: I have to... let's say at a four over there.
cues.zh: 我必須，例如在最後加一個 4。

cues.en: And now this becomes false and this becomes false because three times 3 3 3 3 and then a 4 at the end we'd get just a tiny tiny little bit over 10.
cues.zh: 現在變成 False。因為 3 乘以 3.333、最後再接一個 4，結果就比 10 稍微大一點。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So far I've showed you the strict inequalities: greater than and less than. What I'm going to introduce you to now is greater than or equal to.
cues.zh: 目前介紹的是嚴格不等式，大於和小於。現在介紹大於或等於。

cues.en: So let's start with that example that I showed in the slide.
cues.zh: 從投影片上的例子開始，

cues.en: So that was four is greater than or equal to two plus two.
cues.zh: 4 大於或等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: So now I can press control enter and I get the answer true.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+Enter，得到 True。

cues.en: So that's true because four equals two plus two.
cues.zh: 成立，因為 4 等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: Now if I write two plus two plus one and I run it again and now I get false.
cues.zh: 如果寫 2 加 2 再加 1，重新執行，就得到 False。

cues.en: And that's because four is not greater than five and of course I could make this a minus sign and set
cues.zh: 因為 4 並不大於 5。當然，也能改成減號，讓，

cues.en: this to be true or I can set the right hand side of this inequality to be five.
cues.zh: 結果變成 True；或者把不等式右邊設成 5。

cues.en: And now I'm going to change this to be less than, so I was going to say four is less than or equal to five.
cues.zh: 接著把符號改成小於，也就是「4 小於或等於 5」。

cues.en: And now the answer is true.
cues.zh: 現在答案是 True。

cues.en: The last thing that I want to introduce you to in this video before getting to the exercises is testing
cues.zh: 進入練習前，最後要介紹的是檢查，

cues.en: for equality so now you know how to test for inequality if something is greater than or less than.
cues.zh: 相等。你已經知道，如何檢查大於或小於這種不等關係，

cues.en: But how do you test if something is equal to? You might think it should be something like this.
cues.zh: 但要怎麼檢查相等？你可能覺得應該這樣寫。

cues.en: And if you would just read this out like a mathematical expression this does seem like the right thing to do: four equals two plus two and that is definitely true.
cues.zh: 當成數學式讀，確實合理：4 等於 2 加 2，這當然是真的。

cues.en: However in python a single equals sign like this is not used for equality.
cues.zh: 但 Python 裡，單一等號不用來檢查相等，

cues.en: It's used for variable assignment and that's like what you see up here.
cues.zh: 而是用來指定變數，就像上面看到的。

cues.en: So I'm setting the variable to be equal to the result of this expression.
cues.zh: 把這個運算式的結果，指定給變數。

cues.en: So instead in Python you have to use a double equals sign like this.
cues.zh: 因此，Python 必須像這樣使用兩個等號。

cues.en: So you say four equals equals two plus two.
It's kind of funny looking if you're new to programming, it looks a little weird but it is the right thing to do.
cues.zh: 如果剛開始寫程式，可能覺得看起來很奇怪，但這才是正確寫法。

cues.en: Python outputs true.
cues.zh: Python 輸出 True，

cues.en: And that's because 4 really is equal to two plus two.
cues.zh: 因為 4 確實等於 2 加 2。

cues.en: And now if we wanted to store this outcome so the outcome true in a variable we could say create a new
cues.zh: 如果想把結果，也就是真，存進變數，可以建立新的，

cues.en: variables like theTest equals the result of four equals equals two plus two.
cues.zh: 變數，例如 theTest，等於 4==2+2 的結果。

cues.en: So this is a funny looking expression because you have multiple equals signs floating around here.
cues.zh: 這個式子看起來很有趣，因為有好多等號。

cues.en: But keep in mind that in Python a single equals sign is used to assign some output to some variable.
cues.zh: 但記住，Python 的單一等號，是把某個輸出指定給某個變數。

cues.en: And here the variable is called the test and the double equals sign is used to test for equality.
cues.zh: 這裡變數叫 theTest，兩個等號則用來檢查相等，

cues.en: So whether 4 is the same thing as two plus two.
cues.zh: 也就是 4 是否和 2 加 2 一樣。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I run this code and then I will print out the value of the test and we know that that's going
cues.zh: 執行程式，再印出 theTest 的值，我們知道，

cues.en: to be true. Double equals signs here are really important for using python as a tool for understanding and learning mathematics.
cues.zh: 會是 True。要用 Python 當學習、理解數學的工具，雙等號很重要。

cues.en: And that's because if you try to work out some really complicated equation and you want to see if it's equal to some simpler form of what you think is the same equation then testing for equality is the best
cues.zh: 因為當你處理非常複雜的算式，想確認是否等於你認為相同的簡化形式，檢查相等就是最好的，

cues.en: way to do that. Here is the exercise for this video.
cues.zh: 方式。以下是這段影片的練習。

cues.en: What I have printed here is two inequalities.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個不等式。

cues.en: four x plus three is less than 17 minus X squared and the second one is eight x minus two is less
cues.zh: 4x 加 3，小於 17 減 x 平方；第二個是 8x 減 2，小，

cues.en: than or equal to minus three times x plus forty two. And up here I have three different options for x.
cues.zh: 於或等於 -3x 加 42。上面提供 x 的三種選項，

cues.en: So x can equal 2, X can equal three and X can equal four.
cues.zh: x 可以等於 2、3 或 4。

cues.en: So what you have to do in this assignment is implement these two inequalities in Python and then test
cues.zh: 作業是在 Python 實作這兩個不等式，再測試，

cues.en: for these three different values of X, and what you want to do is figure out which values of x will make these expressions true.
cues.zh: 這三個 x 值，找出哪些值會讓不等式成立。

cues.en: So just to make sure this is clear, I'm going to give a simple example where X equals zero.
cues.zh: 為了說清楚，我用 x=0 做個簡單例子，

cues.en: So that's not one of these options.
cues.zh: 這不在這三個選項裡。

cues.en: But imagine if X were equal to zero then this first expression here would be zero plus three is less than 17 minus zero.
cues.zh: 但假設 x=0，第一個式子會是 0 加 3，小於 17 減 0，

cues.en: So basically three is less than 17.
cues.zh: 基本上就是 3 小於 17。

cues.en: That statement is true.
cues.zh: 這個敘述成立。

cues.en: So therefore when x equals zero this entire statement is true.
cues.zh: 因此，x=0 時，整個敘述為真。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So pause the video, implement this in Python.
cues.zh: 暫停影片，在 Python 裡實作，

cues.en: And check for these two expressions which values have X from this set of three values will make these two expressions be true.
cues.zh: 檢查這三個 x 值，分別有哪些能讓這兩個式子成立。

cues.en: Okay so the way that I'm going to implement this is by setting all of these variables so x equals two X equals three and x equals four.
cues.zh: 我的做法，是先寫出所有指定：x=2、x=3、x=4，

cues.en: And then I'm going to basically uncomment these out one at a time and check whether they make the expression true.
cues.zh: 然後一次取消一行的註解，測試它是否讓式子成立。

cues.en: So let's start with the first one that was I'm going to print this out.
cues.zh: 先看第一題，我把結果印出來。

cues.en: That was four times x plus three is less than 17 minus X.
cues.zh: 4 乘以 x，加 3，小於 17 減 x，

cues.en: Remember X squared is not the caret symbol but it is the two asterisks, two multiplication signs.
cues.zh: 記得，x 的平方不用 caret，而是兩個星號，也就是兩個乘法符號。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do now is comment out these two options for X and I'm doing that by selecting the code and pressing control slash on my keyboard.
cues.zh: 現在把 x 的另外兩個選項註解掉，選取程式碼，按 Ctrl+/。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now this is going to run for x equals two.
cues.zh: 這次會使用 x=2。

cues.en: Okay so that's true and now I'm going to uncomment this line. Notice I'm not commenting this line.
cues.zh: 結果為真。接著取消這行的註解，注意我沒有把上一行註解掉。

cues.en: So when Python reads this line of code it says X equals three.
cues.zh: 所以 Python 讀到這行，會把 x 設為 3，

cues.en: But then it gets the next line of code and it overrides X to be three instead of two.
cues.zh: 但讀到下一行，又把 x 覆寫為 3，而不是 2。

cues.en: I think I said three up here I meant two.
cues.zh: 剛才上面說成 3，應該是 2。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now this is false.
cues.zh: 這次是 False。

cues.en: And now we can check here.
cues.zh: 再來也能測試這裡，

cues.en: But if it's false for three It's certainly going to be false for four.
cues.zh: 但如果 x=3 已經不成立，x=4 肯定也不成立。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we've discovered that for this first equation, this first expression here, this is true only when x equals two out of this set of three numbers.
cues.zh: 因此，對第一個式子，在這三個數字裡，只有 x=2 會成立。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I'm going to repeat this procedure for the second inequality.
cues.zh: 第二個不等式，再重複相同程序。

cues.en: So let's say print and that one was eight times X.
cues.zh: 呼叫 print，這題是 8 乘以 x，

cues.en: You might think that I have an amazing memory but I actually wrote down these equations on a different monitor on my computer.
cues.zh: 你可能以為我記憶力很好，但其實我把算式寫在電腦的另一個螢幕上，

cues.en: So I'm not just calling this all back from memory.
cues.zh: 不是全靠記憶。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that was eight times X minus two is less than or equal to minus three x plus forty two.
cues.zh: 8 乘以 x，減 2，小於或等於 -3x 加 42。

cues.en: And again you have to be careful with this three X because if you're writing this out on paper you would write just the three in the X immediately next to each other like this.
cues.zh: 這裡的 3x 要留意。如果在紙上寫，3 和 x 直接相鄰就可以，

cues.en: However in Python you have to explicitly put an asterisk here.
cues.zh: 但在 Python 裡，必須明確寫出星號。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's try this again.
cues.zh: 再試一次。

cues.en: I'll go starting from x equals two.
cues.zh: 從 x=2 開始。

cues.en: Now this says true true because it's also printing out this one.
cues.zh: 現在顯示兩個 True，因為上面這個式子也還會印出來。

cues.en: So I think just to make things a little easier to comment on this line as well.
cues.zh: 為了簡單一點，我也把那行註解掉。

cues.en: So x equals two makes this expression true X equals three.
cues.zh: x=2 會讓這個式子成立；x=3，

cues.en: Still makes this expression true an x equals four is also true.
